objective: Test one direct scheduled-Chat architecture slice: whether a reasoning worker can durably persist a bounded role-local checkpoint plus exact continuation through lightweight repository transport, without a richer execution-mode handoff, protected-primary mutation, optional hosted-compute quota, or incremental monetary spend.

architecture.name: bounded checkpoint-before-return with CAS/readback
steps: freeze the approved root and reasoning-role authority tuple after exact two-pass reads
execute exactly one bounded reasoning leaf
write one immutable role-local checkpoint containing evidence, tested scope, unresolved items and a nonempty exact continuation
exact-read the written path before returning
on a later invocation, resolve role-local latest state and resume only the recorded continuation under freshly bootstrapped controls

state_machine.BOOTSTRAPPED: authority tuple frozen and clean scope established
state_machine.LEAF_EXECUTED: one bounded leaf has produced a checkpoint candidate
state_machine.READBACK_VERIFIED: exact path is fetched and required fields plus nonempty continuation are present
state_machine.RETURN: normal invocation return; Phase 1 remains open

safety_properties: no O, downstream, other-worker or legacy semantic input
no residual manual-user execution step for this persistence outcome
readback required before relying on persistence
continuation is explicit rather than inferred from conversational history

probe.action: Create this checkpoint through the repository contents interface and exact-read the same path in the same invocation.
accept_if: the exact path can be read back
the frozen authority tuple is unchanged within this artifact
no richer execution mode, hosted runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package compute, cloud/API credit, or manual user execution is used
reject_if: the path cannot be durably read back
a protected or other-role mutation is required
the outcome requires a richer-mode executor or manual user step
the mechanism requires a finite monthly/trial/paid compute or storage allowance

new_material_evidence.claim_under_test: A scheduled-Chat reasoning invocation can externalize its own bounded continuation as durable role-local repository state through lightweight transport, without outsourcing the semantic work to a richer executor.
new_material_evidence.evidence_boundary: Successful create plus exact readback proves only durable checkpoint transport for this role-local text state. It does not prove arbitrary code execution, large artifacts, long-running compute, or global Phase-1 parity.

interpretation.directness: The repository interface transports the checkpoint; it does not perform the reasoning leaf as an external executor.
interpretation.quota_note: No hosted compute or optional monthly credit is used. Lightweight repository transport may be rate-limited; the root policy explicitly permits it as transport only. Rate-limit interruption remains a recovery case rather than an accepted compute dependency.
interpretation.cost_scope: No paid API/service purchase or incremental monetary transaction is invoked by this probe; pre-existing account/service availability is not reclassified as purchased compute.
interpretation.conflict_check: Non-conflicting with Phase-1 reasoning assignment: this tests a direct state/continuation component needed by scheduled-Chat-native architectures and performs no protected-primary or scheduler mutation.

hardened_tests.assertion: Any write outside research_workers_clean_g1/reasoning/ or an explicitly authorized reasoning receipt destination invalidates the probe.
A successful write response without exact path readback is not persistence evidence.
A checkpoint with an empty continuation is invalid even if the write/readback succeeds.
If the architecture requires hosted-runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud or external API/model credits to perform this state-persistence outcome, it fails Phase-1 acceptance.
If the repository transport is asked to execute semantic reasoning rather than only carry state/evidence, that becomes a residual executor and the architecture is not accepted.
A later invocation must re-bootstrap controls before resuming; this checkpoint cannot override newer repository semantic controls.

unresolved_items: test duplicate/replay idempotency with explicit state-version and parent-blob CAS semantics
test recovery when repository transport is temporarily rate-limited without same-run wait/poll/backoff
establish a stable role-local LATEST/STATE pointer convention if none is present
test additional direct Chat-native architecture components needed for richer-mode outcome parity beyond text checkpoint persistence
exact_continuation: Next reasoning invocation: after fresh control bootstrap and own-state resolution, execute exactly one bounded negative slice for duplicate/replay resistance of the checkpoint protocol. Use the current checkpoint blob as the parent identity, model an attempted stale-parent write without touching protected state, require stale-parent rejection or quarantine, persist one role-local result with nonempty continuation, exact-read it back, and do not inspect other-worker/downstream/O/legacy semantics.
user_visible_summary: One bounded Phase-1 reasoning slice tests a direct Chat-native checkpoint/readback architecture. The slice is intentionally narrow and does not claim Phase-1 completion.
